title: Hyperbolic Restricted Boltzmann Machine Neural Quantum State
abstract: arXiv:2609.26032v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We construct the first type of non-Euclidean non-autoregressive neural quantum state (NQS) in the form of the hyperbolic Restricted Boltzmann Machine (HRBM), which is studied in the variational Monte-Carlo (VMC) setting of the Quantum Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (QSK) model whose ground state exhibits volume-law entanglement. Across a 512-fold increase in the Hilbert space dimension corresponding to a system size increase from $N=14$ to $N=24$, HRBM NQS robustly outperforms its Euclidean version, the RBM NQS, in terms of better ground state energy optimization as well as lower Renyi-2 $S_2$ and von Neumann $S_{vN}$ absolute entanglement entropy reconstruction errors. translated_title: 双曲受限玻尔兹曼机神经量子态
translated_abstract: 我们构建了第一类非欧几里得、非自回归的神经量子态（NQS），其形式为双曲受限玻尔兹曼机（HRBM），并在量子Sherrington-Kirkpatrick（QSK）模型的变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）框架下进行研究，该模型的基态呈现体积律纠缠。在希尔伯特空间维度增加512倍（对应系统规模从N=14增加到N=24）的范围内，HRBM NQS稳健地优于其欧几里得版本RBM NQS，具体表现为更好的基态能量优化，以及更低的Renyi-2 S_2和von Neumann S_vN绝对纠缠熵重构误差。更重要的是，对于所有QSK系统规模，HRBM NQS展现出卓越的表达能力，能够忠实地重现QSK模型从最高本征值到尾部、跨越15个数量级的完整纠缠谱，而RBM NQS则始终高估……
tldr: 本文构建了首个非欧几里得的神经量子态——双曲受限玻尔兹曼机（HRBM）NQS，在具有体积律纠缠的量子Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型上，相比传统欧几里得RBM NQS在基态能量优化和跨越15个数量级的完整纠缠谱重现方面展现出显著优势。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs the first non-Euclidean neural quantum state, the Hyperbolic Restricted Boltzmann Machine (HRBM) NQS, which robustly outperforms the Euclidean RBM NQS in ground state energy optimization and faithfully reproduces the entire entanglement spectrum across 15 orders of magnitude for the volume-law entangled Quantum Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model.
